description: Run a full CodeDiag scan of a Node.js project: a 0-100 health score with API health, security, dependency, test, and structure findings, each with a rule ID, file, line, and suggested fix. Security includes Supabase tables without row level security, from supabase/migrations. Most severe findings first. Offline unless audit is true.

audit.description: Also run the package manager's vulnerability audit, which needs network access. Defaults to false.

maxFindings.description: The most findings to return. Defaults to 50.

minSeverity.description: Leave out findings below this severity. Defaults to warning.

path.description: Absolute path of the project directory. Pass it: the server's working directory may not be the project. A relative path resolves against that working directory, the default.

name: scan_project
title: Scan project health
